goal: Users are being logged out at random while they're in the middle of using the app.

entries.content: Users are being logged out at random while they're in the middle of using the app.
ran: git status — clean working tree
read src/components/LogoutButton.tsx — styling for the log out button in the header
read src/app/layout.tsx — app shell, top nav, and footer
ran: grep -rn 'random' src — only Math.random in the confetti animation
read src/users/avatar.ts — user avatar upload and resizing
ran: tail server access log — 401 responses spike on /api/* about 15 minutes after each sign-in, then the client redirects to /signin
read package.json — react, express, jsonwebtoken, vitest
read docs/user-guide.md — how users change their display name in the app
read src/auth/token.ts — access token lifetime is 15 minutes; renewal happens lazily on the first 401
read src/app/analytics.ts — tracks page views while users are in the middle of checkout
ran: npm install — added 388 packages
read src/auth/refresh.ts — the refresh endpoint rotates the refresh token and invalidates the previous one immediately
read src/users/list.tsx — admin table of users, paginated
ran: npm run lint — 0 errors
grep 'clearCredentials' src — called from the 403 handler in src/api/client.ts
ran: npm run build — app bundle is 412kb
ran: opened two tabs, waited 15 minutes, clicked in both — the second tab's refresh gets 403 'refresh token reused', which clears credentials and bounces to /signin
read CHANGELOG.md — 'app: new onboarding flow for users'
ran: docker ps — api and postgres containers running
Two tabs race to renew with the same token. Rotation invalidates it on first use, so the second renewal fails and the client treats that as a revoked credential.
read src/app/theme.ts — light and dark color tokens
ran: git log --oneline -5 — recent commits about the onboarding copy
edited src/auth/refresh.ts — accept the previous refresh token for a 30-second grace window after rotation
read src/users/settings.tsx — notification preferences form
ran: npm test -- auth.test.ts — new concurrent-renewal test passes
ran: ls public — favicon, robots.txt, images/
read .github/workflows/ci.yml — runs lint and test on node 22
